full_drive_wipe.description: The full-drive workflow can destroy data on the selected device. Verify drive identity and back up needed files before confirming.

single_file_wipe.description: Per-file erasure depends on filesystem metadata and storage technology. Deleted-file entries without trustworthy physical extents cannot be safely treated as exact wipe targets.

recover_file.description: Avoid new writes to the source when recovery matters and use a separate destination. The assistant must not promise recovery unless the application supplies a result.

recover_drive.description: Review the supported scan result and its limitations. The assistant must not assume the current build supports every recovery workflow.
